lines.en: My clawed feet scrape the tiles.
I step in jerks, joints creaking.
My yellow feathers brush the wall and shed dust.
I walk very straight, as if on rails.

lines.zh: 我的围裙带子垂在腿边。
lines.en: My apron strings hang by my legs.
I cross the corridor and the lights go out behind me.
I don't turn; I shoulder the door open.
Every few steps I stop.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在门框上刮了一道。
lines.en: My claw gouges the door frame.
I drag my right foot.
I head toward the noise.
I stand at the end of the corridor, still.
My beak is open and will not close.
The bulb above me flickers.
My hands hang low, claws long.
I count the red dots of the cameras.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，只是站着。
lines.en: I don't need air; I only stand.

lines.zh: 我的围裙上有一块污渍。
lines.en: There is a stain on my apron.
I stay motionless until you turn.
My eyes are two little lamps.

lines.zh: 你不该在这个时候走动。
lines.en: You shouldn't be walking at this hour.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，脖子弯得很怪。
lines.en: I look down at you; my neck bends oddly.
Your torch is on my face.
Closing the door won't help.
The wall's behind you; nowhere left.

lines.zh: 我的喙对着你一张一合。
lines.en: My beak opens and shuts at you.
You don't scream. I prefer that.

lines.zh: 我在看你有没有带工具。
lines.en: I'm checking whether you carry tools.

lines.zh: 我胸口的铁架被砸凹了。
lines.en: The frame at my chest is dented in.
The motor's pitch has changed.
I step back and my knee jams.
A few feathers came off.
You can move me, but not enough.
I raise a hand to block.
Something has come loose inside.

lines.zh: 我直起来，关节一节节归位。
lines.en: I straighten up, joints snapping into place.
My claws are still here.
That cannot be eaten.
Even if you offer, I won't take it.
My beak won't close; I cannot bite.
I tilt my head, uninterested.
Does this thing make noise?
I smell oil and iron.
I only chase monsters, not you.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，还是盯着你。
lines.en: I step back, still watching you.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口的铁架上。
lines.en: You hit the metal frame in my chest.
I don't budge; you do.
Under my feathers it's all metal.
My weight shoves you aside.
My claw is on your shoe.

lines.zh: 别贴着我，我的关节会卡。
lines.en: Don't press close; my joints jam.

lines.zh: 铁壳和你的肩膀碰了一声。
lines.en: My casing rings off your shoulder.
I put a hand on the wall to steady myself.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞歪了我的头。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked my head askew.

lines.zh: 我是机器，只有骨架和羽毛。
lines.en: I am a machine: frame and feathers.
There is only an endoskeleton inside me.
Don't come near.
I shake my head; a motor whirs.

lines.zh: 我不谈恋爱，我得去赶怪。
lines.en: No romance for me; I have monsters to chase.

lines.zh: 我站在你旁边，但不为这个。
lines.en: I stand beside you, but not for that.
My hand stops halfway up.

lines.zh: 你说话我听得到，仅此而已。
lines.en: I hear you speak. That's all.

lines.zh: 别跟着我，巡逻路线不带你。
lines.en: Do not follow; the patrol route is not for you.
My claw picks it up and offers it.
This fits in my pocket.

lines.zh: 不是客人的，我摆回架子上。
lines.en: Not a guest's; I put it back on the shelf.
It rattles in my hand.
I set it on the counter.

lines.zh: 这个能垫在展台的歪脚下面。
lines.en: This can shim the display stand's bad leg.

lines.zh: 这披萨盒，我替你压扁收好。
lines.en: I will flatten this pizza box and keep it for you.
I poke it with a claw tip. Soft.
I bend slowly so as not to jam.
You're still in the corridor.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩到地砖的接缝。
lines.en: I heard you step on a tile seam.
I've started counting your steps.

lines.zh: 你那件工具挡不住我的爪子。
lines.en: That tool won't stop my claws.
The corridor has one exit.
Do you hear my steps?
When the lights go out, I arrive.
Your back is against the wall.
You finally looked back.
Your hand is on the handle.
I dig my claws into the wall.

lines.zh: 这一层的监控灭了两个。
lines.en: Two cameras on this floor just died.
Don't bother counting. The corridor is long.
I come along the corridor.
You're behind the door. I know.

lines.zh: 我不用呼吸，所以你不会听见。
lines.en: I don't breathe, so you won't hear me.
I put my hand on the handle.
The door warps in my grip.
You've backed into a camera blind spot.

lines.zh: 我数到七就拐进这条走廊。
lines.en: I count to seven, then take this hall.
I circle around the other way.
I walk with claws scraping the wall.
Do you hear the current hum?
I stop three blocks behind you.

lines.zh: 我把爪子从墙里抽出来。
lines.en: I pull my claws out of the wall.
Listen — that's metal ringing.
The door behind you has shut.
Step by step, my joints are noisy.

lines.zh: 别躲，我的喙已经对准你。
lines.en: Do not hide. My beak is aimed at you.
I hug the wall; you won't hear.
I reach into the vent.
Wherever you run, it's corridor.
My claws sweep down.
One rake tears your sleeve.
I ram you into the wall.
My beak snaps loudly.
I press you to the tiles.
That nearly flipped you over.

lines.zh: 我不怕击退，你推不动我。
lines.en: Knockback means nothing; you can't push me.
My claw tips are long.
Retreat more and there is no way out.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，慢慢落下。
lines.en: I lift one foot and let it fall.
You hear metal hit the floor.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手臂，往下拽。
lines.en: I seize your arm and yank it down.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在墙上留了四道。
lines.en: My claws leave four lines on the wall.
I crush a floor tile underfoot.

lines.zh: 我的喙卡了一下，又咬下来。
lines.en: My beak jams, then snaps shut.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整条手臂的重量。
lines.en: That blow carried my whole arm's weight.
You blocked the wrong place.
I lift you up and set you down.
I stand on the stage as the lights come up.

lines.zh: 我的关节自己转了几下。
lines.en: My joints rotate a few times on their own.
It's quiet here. Too quiet.
I come down the steps, one clang each.
The show hasn't started.
First I straighten my apron.
The air tastes of dust.
I hear someone in the corridor.
My head caught for a moment.
I begin my patrol.
The tube light flickers three times.

lines.zh: 火燎到羽毛，我不喜欢这个温度。
lines.en: Fire catches my feathers; I dislike that heat.
I fell and my leg is crooked.

lines.zh: 水进了我的关节，转不动了。
lines.en: Water got into my joints; they won't turn.
The blast throws me onto the stage.
Something is lodged in my casing.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我的电路乱了。
lines.en: Violet light scrambles my circuits.

lines.zh: 雷光打在我身上，灯全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits and every light comes on.
I am not supposed to fall.
